name: Dakidarts Numerology Core
author: Dakidarts

sections.description:
Dakidarts Numerology Core connects your WordPress site to the Dakidarts Numerology API.
With this plugin, you can:

  • Use over 35 numerology endpoints (life path, sun number, challenge number, karmic debts, personality number, personal year/month/day, soul expression, soul urge, phone number analysis, and more)
  • Choose between RapidAPI or the NumerologyAPI Gateway
  • Use multi-language output with the Gateway (en, fr, es, de, pt)
  • Display interactive forms anywhere with shortcodes
  • Drag and drop Gutenberg blocks for easy page building
  • Customize templates for forms and results
  • Extend the plugin with category add-ons (Love, Career, Health, etc.)
  • Securely store your API key with AES-256 encryption
  • Fully translation-ready

Whether you’re a spiritual blogger or a numerology enthusiast, this plugin brings the power of the Dakidarts Numerology API directly to your WordPress site.

Arbitrary Section

For more info and API documentation, visit: https://docs.numerologyapi.com/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the dakidarts-numerology-core folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Dakidarts Numerology > Settings in the admin dashboard, choose your API route (Gateway or RapidAPI), and enter your API key.
  4. Use shortcodes like [dakidarts_numerology endpoint="life-path"] or drag & drop the Gutenberg blocks onto any page.
  5. Customize templates and styling as needed.
sections.faq:
Can I use this plugin without an API key?

No. You need a valid API key (Gateway or RapidAPI) to fetch numerology and horoscope data.

Where do I get a Gateway API key?

You can create or manage your key at https://dashboard.numerologyapi.com/login.

Does the Gateway support multiple languages?

Yes. The Gateway supports en, fr, es, de, and pt. Language can be selected in the plugin settings when using the Gateway route.

Can I create my own templates?

Yes! You can override the default templates by copying them into your theme or add-on folders.

Are my API keys stored securely?

Yes. The plugin encrypts the API key using AES-256 before storing it in the database.

Does it work with Gutenberg?

Absolutely. The plugin includes custom Gutenberg blocks for easy drag & drop usage.
